title: Geometric Algebra for Neural Networks: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.30121v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geometric algebra (GA) unifies geometric primitives and transformations in a single algebraic framework. Neural networks designed around this framework often represent features as multivectors and constrain layer operations to respect the algebraic structure, enabling principled treatment of geometric transformations and, in many cases, built-in equivariance. This survey reviews geometric algebra neural networks, including their building blocks, equivariant properties, application domains, empirical performance, and software support. We provide an algebra-selection guide, an empirical comparison of GA-based and other equivariant architectures, and a failure-mode analysis covering training pathologies, deployment constraints, and performance limitations. translated_title: 面向神经网络的几何代数：综述
translated_abstract: 几何代数（GA）在单一的代数框架中统一了几何基元和几何变换。围绕该框架设计的神经网络通常将特征表示为多重向量（multivectors），并约束层运算以遵循代数结构，从而能够对几何变换进行有原则的处理，且在许多情况下内置等变性。本综述回顾了几何代数神经网络，包括其基本构件、等变性质、应用领域、实证性能和软件支持。我们提供了代数选择指南、基于GA的架构与其他等变架构的实证比较，以及涵盖训练病态、部署约束和性能局限的失效模式分析。纵观所调研的文献，基于GA的架构最有力的证据出现在具有显式几何对称性和异质几何实体的场景中；证据……
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了几何代数神经网络的基本构件、等变性、应用与实证表现，指出基于几何代数的架构在具有显式几何对称性和异质几何实体的场景中优势最为显著。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews geometric algebra neural networks—their building blocks, equivariance, applications, and empirical performance—and finds that GA-based architectures show the strongest advantages in settings with explicit geometric symmetries and heterogeneous geometric entities.
